tasks.short: Develop and document security procedures and policies

steps.what: Develop security requirements and select authoritative policy and site evidence
Document the selected security procedure in the required policy structure

loop.purpose: Draft procedural wording from already selected requirements
loop.input: Supervisor brief, checked source pack and policy template
loop.output: Draft procedure with paragraph-level source references and unresolved gaps
loop.check: Supervisor verifies every duty, actor, exception and escalation against the brief and sources; rejects invented powers or obligations
loop.stop: One draft; unresolved source conflicts or unsafe instructions return to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Procedural wording synthesises different texts; fixed field replacement cannot express contextual instructions

steps.what: Validate practical and legal requirements and submit the exact procedure for owner approval
outputs: validated procedure submitted for owner review

tasks.design: Use a bounded draft within {DOCS} from supervisor-selected requirements and sources. The supervisor checks meaning and practical instructions before submitting the exact version; the existing policy owner retains formal approval and release.
tasks.previous_blocker: Writing consistent procedural wording repeats source synthesis.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded drafting step can propose wording with traceable source references.
tasks.still_hard: Conflicting requirements and real site exceptions need authoritative interpretation.
tasks.human_edge: The supervisor knows whether an instruction is lawful, practical and safe to execute.
tasks.altitude: Less first-draft writing with unchanged procedure-development and submission responsibility.

reach.task: Provide a traceable draft for policy review
reach.learn: Source hierarchy and operational procedure validation

evidence.claim: Bounded drafting of security procedures from checked sources is an E1 design from model knowledge; the digest supplies no measured policy-writing case.

assumptions: Boundary is supervisor procedure development and submission; formal owner approval, legal specialist work and publication remain separate unchanged activities.

Supervisor s1 produces the brief with scope, responsibilities, action sequence, exceptions, escalation and source versions; capture and source selection stay in40 hours. Missing or contradictory requirements return to manual development.
Test existing document templates and approved drafting support before custom code. No model invents access powers or legal authority.
Formal owner review already exists; additional draft-audit effort is costed below. Confirm national rules locally.
unknowns: Source quality, drafting environment and policy approval ownership
research_questions: Does source-bound drafting save time after every instruction and exception is checked?

already_counted.description: Final practical validation and submission approval

approvals.approved_version: Exact procedure version, source pack and intended policy-owner audience; any change voids submission approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R86 gross14 minus5 focal upkeep gives net9. E1 routine-update scenario; source conflicts or redrafting reduce net to0-6 while requirement judgement and final validation retain full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Agree emergency training objectives, feasible times, participants and operational safeguards
Enter the agreed training or drill details in the scheduling record
Check operational safety and booking accuracy and approve training invitations

tasks.design: Configure reuse of agreed booking fields between {CALENDAR} and {LMS}. The supervisor keeps operational coordination and checks the exact event before invitations; scheduling software does not decide when a realistic emergency drill is safe.
tasks.previous_blocker: Agreed event details are entered again across booking records.
tasks.enabler_now: Native calendar links and training templates can reuse confirmed details.
tasks.still_hard: A free calendar slot does not establish safe staffing or drill conditions.
tasks.human_edge: The supervisor recognises operational conflicts and coordinates appropriate safeguards.
tasks.altitude: Less booking re-entry with unchanged drill-scheduling authority.

reach.task: Maintain a complete agreed emergency-training booking
reach.learn: Operational constraints and training record fields

evidence.claim: Reusing agreed event fields in training scheduling is an E1 design from model knowledge; no emergency-drill scheduling case is supplied by the digest.

assumptions: Boundary is scheduling, excluding emergency scenario design, drill authorisation by others and training execution.

Supervisor s1 captures event type, approved objectives, date, start and end time, site, trainer, participant IDs, coverage arrangement and invitation text within60 hours. Missing agreement or fields return to manual booking.
Existing site and training owners supply requirements and availability through unchanged coordination. No free safe-slot flag is assumed.
Test native event templates and links before code; benefit requires actual duplicate entry rather than existing automatic synchronisation.
unknowns: Scheduling systems and genuine duplicate booking effort
research_questions: Can field reuse save entry time while retaining operational coordination and invitation checks?

incremental.description: Calendar mapping and booking exception checks

approvals.approved_version: Exact event time, location, trainer, participants, safeguards and invitation text; any change voids approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R75 gross25 minus4 upkeep gives net21. E1 duplicate-booking scenario; corrections and special events can reduce net to4-15 without shortening coordination.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Log keys and key cards distributed to persons

steps.what: Log items distributed to identified persons and verify the actual key or key-card handover

tasks.design: Replace the handwritten distribution log with a native issue form in the access-control record, represented by {OTHER}. The supervisor still verifies the person and actual item and captures each handover; the form neither grants access nor infers that handover occurred.
tasks.previous_blocker: Handwritten logs repeat labels and require legible entry of identifiers.
tasks.enabler_now: A fixed form can reuse field labels and validate required formats.
tasks.still_hard: A valid-looking identifier does not prove the correct person received the correct key.
tasks.human_edge: The supervisor checks the physical item and recipient before confirming the log.
tasks.altitude: A more consistent issue record with unchanged access authority.

evidence.claim: A required-field distribution log is an E1 design from model knowledge; the digest supplies no measured key-logging case.

assumptions: Boundary is supervisor logging and verification, excluding granting access, programming cards and other staff's physical issue work.

Supervisor s1 personally observes and captures recipient ID, item ID, handover time, issuer ID and any return due date in the remaining85 hours. No external producer supplies a free distributed flag; uncertain identity or handover requires manual reconciliation.
Use native access-record forms before code; all field capture, corrections and checking remain human. The only proposed reduction is repeated handwriting and formatting.
No tracking or automatic access decision is added; confirm national employee-data consultation requirements.
unknowns: Current paper-log workload and access-record form support
research_questions: Does the form reduce logging time after observing handover and correcting identifiers?

already_counted.description: Observation, field capture and custody verification

incremental.description: Form checks and unresolved custody-entry review

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R85 gross15 minus4 upkeep gives net11. E1 paper-log scenario; corrections or little handwriting burden reduce net to0-7. Physical handover and identity checks are not reduced.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Define department budget needs and capture checked cost and staffing assumptions
Calculate department budget totals and format standard budget tables
Check calculations and write the department budget explanation and trade-offs
Present the budget to management or stakeholders and explain department priorities

tasks.design: Configure checked formulas and standard budget tables in {SPREADSHEET}. The supervisor keeps assumption selection, budget explanation and presentation; management retains budget approval and no spending authority is automated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated arithmetic and table formatting adds preparation work.
tasks.enabler_now: Native formulas can reproduce fixed cost calculations.
tasks.still_hard: A numerically correct budget may omit operational needs or use unrealistic staffing assumptions.
tasks.human_edge: The supervisor explains operational trade-offs and defends priorities.
tasks.altitude: Less table assembly with unchanged budget recommendation authority.

reach.task: Explain budget variances and assumptions clearly

evidence.claim: Fixed budget calculations and tables are an E1 design from model knowledge; the digest supplies no security-budget labour case.

assumptions: Boundary is supervisor budget proposal and presentation, excluding finance ledger maintenance, management approval and purchasing.

Supervisor s1 verifies and captures period, cost centre, cost category, unit, quantity, rate, currency, staffing hours and assumption version within45 hours. Existing finance records supply historical costs and approved rates through unchanged work.
Missing units, disputed rates or unsupported assumptions return to manual budget preparation. Test native spreadsheet templates before custom code.
No free forecast or approved-cost flag is presumed; no model is needed for arithmetic.
unknowns: Current manual table effort and reliable cost inputs
research_questions: Do checked tables reduce preparation time after including reconciliation and stakeholder revisions?

already_counted.description: Budget assumption selection and field capture

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R80 gross20 minus4 upkeep gives net16. E1 recurring-budget scenario; reconciliation and changing categories lower net to3-12 while judgement and presentation remain fully counted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce first-draft wording, duplicate booking and fixed table work while retaining security judgement and operational coordination.
reach: Provide source-traceable policy drafts to compliance staff
Explain department cost assumptions to finance
role.ambitious_version: A supervisor who maintains clear security procedures and reliable records while protecting time for practical operational decisions.
